notes: Major Trickster redesign with directional Hook, Proximity Mine, and Springboard.
Hook now supports Multishot, manual retraction, cancellation, and retrieving power-ups.
Wizard fireballs are stronger earlier in rounds, and Rebound behavior is fixed across all arcs.
Chain Caldera now takes structural damage and gains a timed spiral collapse.
Added a new soundtrack for the menu and every arena.
Added Match Settings, Balance Lab profiles, display/UI improvements, and fixes. Older builds must update for protocol 11 multiplayer.
